purpose: Convert repeated, evidence-backed Qarğa work patterns into controlled improvement proposals without autonomous mutation of permanent rules.

confidenceLevels.repeated: At least two independent observations with a shared signal.
confidenceLevels.validated: An approved improvement succeeded across at least three relevant tasks.
confidenceLevels.retired: The learning was contradicted, obsolete, harmful, or superseded.

automaticActions: append an observation to the project ledger
aggregate recurring signals into a review report
forbiddenAutomaticActions: promote a proposal into a permanent rule

approvalRules.documentation: Coordinator approval; project-owner approval when the document changes a product or operating decision.
approvalRules.checklist: Coordinator approval and review by the affected role.
approvalRules.skill: Coordinator approval, independent QA review, and project-owner approval before permanent registration.
approvalRules.agent-prompt: Coordinator proposal, independent QA review, and project-owner approval.
approvalRules.command: Coordinator proposal and QA review; project-owner approval when it changes decision or permission boundaries.
approvalRules.hook: Security review and explicit project-owner approval.
approvalRules.integration: Security review, cost/permission analysis, and explicit project-owner approval.
approvalRules.workflow-routing: Coordinator proposal, QA review, and project-owner approval.

privacyRules: Do not store secrets, credentials, tokens, personal data, or raw private conversations.
Do not store unsupported market figures or claims as learned facts.
Project-specific learning remains in the Qarğa repository.
Repository code, CLAUDE.md, official documentation, and approved decisions outrank learning records.
